subject: executor: fix select wrong partition for hash partition table (#50430)
summary: Reviewed planner hash-partition pruning change in `pkg/planner/core/rule_partition_processor.go`: range pruning now computes each candidate partition via `abs((posLow+i)%N)` instead of using a precomputed `posLow%N` offset. This matches runtime hash partition routing in `pkg/table/tables/partition.go:1452` (signed `%` then negate if negative), fixing wrong partition selection for negative ranges around multiples of N and BIGINT UNSIGNED values beyond 2^63 (as reflected by the added integration-test expectations for partitions p3/p4 and p0/p6). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched planner logic; later upstream/master retains the same per-value modulo approach (moved file path).
